links.title: See 'Composing a Declaration' page for information on the the BIG-IP AS3 Request body.
See 'Composing a Declaration' page for information on the the BIG-IP AS3 Request body.
See 'Composing a Declaration' page for information on the the BIG-IP AS3 Request body.

async.description: **async=**: *true* causes BIG-IP AS3 to respond with a 202 status and a request ID which you can later use in a GET request to a new **/task** endpoint to get the results.  Default is **false**.
async.name: async

controlsDryRun.description:
BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: Using **controls.dryRun=true** sends the declaration through all validation checks but does not attempt to deploy the configuration on the target device.  This can be useful for testing and debugging declarations. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
The default is **false**.
controlsDryRun.name: controls.dryRun

controlsLogLevel.description:
BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: Determines the level of detail in logs using RFC 5424 severity levels. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
The default is **error**.
controlsLogLevel.name: controls.logLevel

controlsTrace.description:
BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: If true, BIG-IP AS3 creates a detailed trace of the configuration process for subsequent analysis (default false). Warning: Trace files may contain sensitive configuration data. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
The default is **false**.
controlsTrace.name: controls.trace

controlsTraceResponse.description:
BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: If true, the response will contain the trace files. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
The default is **false**.
controlsTraceResponse.name: controls.traceResponse

controlsUserAgent.description: BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: User Agent information to include in TEEM report. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
controlsUserAgent.name: controls.userAgent

show.description: **show=**: *base* means system returns the declaration as originally deployed (but with secrets like passphrases encrypted), *full* returns the declaration with all default schema properties populated, *expanded* includes all URLs, base64s, and other references expanded to their final static values.  Default is **base**
show.name: show

showHash.description:
If you set **showHash=true**, the results include an optimisticLockKey for each tenant.
Attempts to change/update any of the tenants *without* the correct optimisticLockKey will fail.
The default is **false**.
showHash.name: showHash

tenant.description:
Only use the specified tenants. Other tenants in the declaration will be ignored. May be a comma
separated list.
tenant.name: tenant

tenantForApplication.description: Tenant in which to create the application. Tenant will be created if it doesn't exist.
tenantForApplication.name: tenant

id.description: A unique identifier for the task

results.description: The results of the asynchronous task per-tenant

500.description: Something went wrong internally, and a bug report should be filed: https://github.com/F5Networks/f5-appsvcs-extension/issues/new/choose

example.message: Error: Configuration operation in progress on device undefined, please try again in 2 minutes

503.description: BIG-IP AS3 is currently processing a configuration, and cannot process another at this time

externalDocs.description: See 'Composing a Declaration' page for information on the the BIG-IP AS3 Request body.

code.description: HTTP status code describing the outcome of applying the tenant's configuration. This will be 0 until the tenant is done being processed.

host.description: The host name that the tenant was deployed on.

lineCount.description: The number of lines in the tenant's configuration.

message.description: The current status of the task to configure the tenant.

runTime.description: The time (in milliseconds) it took to process the tenant.

settings-schema.description: A declarative configuration for BIG-IP AS3

asyncTaskStorage.description: Control where asynchronous tasks are stored. Existing tasks are not transferred when the storage type is changed. Storing tasks in a data group persists the data between restarts, but puts more pressure on the control plane.
asyncTaskStorage.title: Asynchronous Task Storage

burstHandlingEnabled.description: A boolean that controls if BIG-IP AS3 on this BIG-IP system uses the Burst Handling feature
burstHandlingEnabled.title: Burst Handling Enabled

deletePartitionWhenTenantDeleted.description: Whether or not to delete the underlying partition when the tenant is deleted. Set to false if the partition has objects not controlled by AS3 or otherwise need to be preserved.
deletePartitionWhenTenantDeleted.title: Delete Partition When Tenant Deleted

encodeDeclarationMetadata.description: A boolean that controls encoding the metadata of declaration before storing in a datagroup.
encodeDeclarationMetadata.title: Enable AS3 declaration metadata encoding

perAppDeploymentAllowed.description: Whether or not to allow per-application deployments
perAppDeploymentAllowed.title: Per Application Deployment

performanceTracingEnabled.description: A boolean that controls if BIG-IP AS3 records performance information. Jaeger client must be installed to enable.
performanceTracingEnabled.title: Performance Tracing Enabled

performanceTracingEndpoint.description: Remote endpoint to which performance tracing will send data
performanceTracingEndpoint.title: Performance Tracing Endpoint

serializeFileUploads.description: When uploading files to the BIG-IP, do so in serial rather than parallel. Use this setting if you have lots of files (like certificates) in your declaration and are running into a 'Too many open files' error in restjavad.
serializeFileUploads.title: Serialize File Uploads

serviceDiscoveryEnabled.description: A boolean that controls if Service Discovery features are enabled
serviceDiscoveryEnabled.title: Service Discovery Enabled

settings-schema.title: F5 BIG-IP AS3 Settings Declaration

info.description: This reference describes the BIG-IP AS3 API and available endpoints.
info.title: F5 BIG-IP AS3

delete.description: Use DELETE to remove configurations for one or more declared Tenants from the target ADC.

parameters.description:
**base** means system returns the declaration as originally deployed (but with secrets like passphrases encrypted), **full** returns the declaration with all default schema properties populated, **expanded** includes all URLs, base64s, and other references expanded to their final static values.
The default is **base**.
parameters.name: show

results.description: The results of the task per-tenant

get.description: Retrieve a declaration (with all or just some Tenants) or an index of stored declarations.

parameters.description:
**base** means system returns the declaration as originally deployed (but with secrets like passphrases encrypted), **full** returns the declaration with all default schema properties populated, **expanded** includes all URLs, base64s, and other references expanded to their final static values.
The default is **base**.
parameters.name: show

parameters.description:
?age=0-15 asks for a declaration of the given age (0 means most-recently deployed), and "list" asks for a list of available declarations with their ages.
By default, **list** only shows 4 declarations, this is configurable using **historyLimit** in the BIG-IP AS3 class.
The default is 0.
parameters.name: age

parameters.description:
You can use filterClass to retrieve results for only a specific BIG-IP AS3 class.
For example **?filterClass=HTTP_Profile** only returns the HTTP Profile portions of the declaration.
You can only use filterClass once in a single GET request.
parameters.name: filterClass

204.description: No BIG-IP AS3 configured tenants exist on the target device

patch.description: You can use the PATCH method to modify the configuration produced by a previously-sent declaration without having to resend the entire declaration

parameters.description:
**base** means system returns the declaration as originally deployed (but with secrets like passphrases encrypted), **full** returns the declaration with all default schema properties populated, **expanded** includes all URLs, base64s, and other references expanded to their final static values.
The default is **base**.
parameters.name: show

parameters.description: Setting async to **true** causes BIG-IP AS3 to respond with a 202 status and a request ID which you can later use in a GET request to a new **/task** endpoint to get the results.
parameters.name: async

Apply BIG-IP AS3 configuration
Use POST to deploy a configuration to a target ADC, or for certain other actions, including
retrieve
.
You must supply a request document with each POST.
The request document may be a proper request or a ADC-only declaration
query
Parameters
async
boolean
async=
:
true
causes BIG-IP AS3 to respond with a 202 status and a request ID which you can later use in a GET request to a new
/task
endpoint to get the results.  Default is
false
.
controls.dryRun
boolean
BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: Using
controls.dryRun=true
sends the declaration through all validation checks but does not attempt to deploy the configuration on the target device.  This can be useful for testing and debugging declarations. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
The default is
false
.
controls.logLevel
string
BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: Determines the level of detail in logs using RFC 5424 severity levels. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
The default is
error
.
controls.trace
boolean
BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: If true, BIG-IP AS3 creates a detailed trace of the configuration process for subsequent analysis (default false). Warning: Trace files may contain sensitive configuration data. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
The default is
false
.
controls.traceResponse
boolean
BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: If true, the response will contain the trace files. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
The default is
false
.
controls.userAgent
string
BIG-IP AS3 3.30+: User Agent information to include in TEEM report. Using this query parameter overwrites any Controls in the ADC class you specified in the declaration.
show
string
show=
:
base
means system returns the declaration as originally deployed (but with secrets like passphrases encrypted),
full
returns the declaration with all default schema properties populated,
expanded
includes all URLs, base64s, and other references expanded to their final static values.  Default is
base
showHash
boolean
If you set
showHash=true
, the results include an optimisticLockKey for each tenant.
Attempts to change/update any of the tenants
without
the correct optimisticLockKey will fail.
The default is
false
.

Read current BIG-IP AS3 configuration
Retrieve a declaration (with all or just some Tenants) or an index of stored declarations.
query
Parameters
show
string
base
means system returns the declaration as originally deployed (but with secrets like passphrases encrypted),
full
returns the declaration with all default schema properties populated,
expanded
includes all URLs, base64s, and other references expanded to their final static values.
The default is
base
.
age
integer or string
?age=0-15 asks for a declaration of the given age (0 means most-recently deployed), and "list" asks for a list of available declarations with their ages.
By default,
list
only shows 4 declarations, this is configurable using
historyLimit
in the BIG-IP AS3 class.
The default is 0.
filterClass
string
You can use filterClass to retrieve results for only a specific BIG-IP AS3 class.
For example
?filterClass=HTTP_Profile
only returns the HTTP Profile portions of the declaration.
You can only use filterClass once in a single GET request.
Responses
200
Successful response
204
No BIG-IP AS3 configured tenants exist on the target device
500
Something went wrong internally, and a bug report should be filed:
https://github.com/F5Networks/f5-appsvcs-extension/issues/new/choose
